prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose first temple was dedicated before 1960.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country whose first temple of the Church was dedicated before 1960.
prompts.summary: For most of its history the Church's temples stood in the United States, with St. George, Utah (1877) the oldest still on the list. Before 1960 only four other countries had one: Canada (Cardston, 1923), Switzerland (near Bern, 1955, the first in Europe), and New Zealand and the United Kingdom (both 1958).

prompts.display_text: Pin an African country where a current Seventy served as a missionary or mission leader (October 2026).
prompts.text_original: As of October 2026, several General Authority Seventies had served as young missionaries or as mission leaders in Africa. Pin an African country where one of their missions was headquartered, as named in the Church's official biographies.
prompts.summary: Africa is now a training ground for Church leaders. As of October 2026, current Seventies had served or presided in missions based in nine African countries, from Nigeria and Ghana to Angola, Mozambique and Benin. Elder Edward Dube served both as a young missionary and as a mission president in his native Zimbabwe.

answers.name: Nigeria
answers.fact: Lagos and Port Harcourt missionaries (Egbo, Morrison); Enugu and Calabar mission presidents (Chigbundu, Egbo).

answers.name: Ghana
answers.fact: Elder Isaac K. Morrison presided over the Ghana Cape Coast Mission.

answers.name: South Africa
answers.fact: Elder Matswagothata served in the Cape Town mission; Elder Dunn led the Johannesburg mission.

answers.name: Ivory Coast
answers.fact: Elder Thierry K. Mutombo served in the Cote d'Ivoire Abidjan Mission.

answers.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
answers.fact: Elder Alfred Kyungu presided over the Mbuji-Mayi mission, 2016 to 2019.

answers.name: Zimbabwe
answers.fact: Elder Edward Dube: young missionary in Zimbabwe, later president of the Zimbabwe Harare Mission.

answers.name: Mozambique
answers.fact: Elder Joni L. Koch presided over the Mozambique Maputo Mission.

answers.name: Angola
answers.fact: Elder Denelson Silva presided over the Angola Luanda Mission.

answers.name: Benin
answers.fact: Elder D. Martin Goury presided over the Benin Cotonou Mission.
